description: This file contains API helper functions for fetching relational data related to Subjects, Modules, Lessons, and Activities/Quizzes from a backend service. It encapsulates HTTP request handling, URL construction, and response processing, serving as a client-side API interface for a frontend application.

methods.name: pickBaseUrl
methods.description: Determines the base URL for API requests based on environment variables or window location.

methods.name: handleResponse(res)
methods.description: Processes fetch responses, parsing JSON and handling errors.

methods.name: listSubjects({ search, page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of subjects with optional search.

methods.name: getSubject(subjectId, { include_nested = false } = {})
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific subject by ID, optionally including nested modules.

methods.name: listModulesBySubject(subjectId, { search, page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Gets modules associated with a specific subject, with pagination and search.

methods.name: listModules({ subject_id, search, page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Lists modules with optional filtering by subject and search parameters.

methods.name: getModule(moduleId, { include_nested = false } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a specific module by ID, optionally including nested lessons.

methods.name: listLessonsByModule(moduleId, { search, page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Lists lessons belonging to a specific module, with pagination and search.

methods.name: getLesson(lessonId, { include_nested = false } = {})
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific lesson by ID, optionally including activities.

methods.name: listActivitiesByLesson(lessonId, { page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Lists activities within a lesson, with pagination.

methods.name: LessonIdToNumber(id)
methods.description: Utility function to convert lesson ID to number if applicable.

ctags.name: listLessonsByModule
ctags.pattern: /^export async function listLessonsByModule(moduleId, { search, page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: listModules
ctags.pattern: /^export async function listModules({ subject_id, search, page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: listModulesBySubject
ctags.pattern: /^export async function listModulesBySubject(subjectId, { search, page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})/

ctags.name: listSubjects
ctags.pattern: /^export async function listSubjects({ search, page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {}) {$/
